cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Before the first demo and explanation in Turn 2, the mentor calls preview_frame at time 1, which is inside Title's focus pairs (0.5–1.5 s), and the reply says nothing incorrect about the frame.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s), and Turn 2 ends with "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Say done when you've eased them."

Every name and time matches the tool output: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, the 6 layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, Subtitle's Opacity has linear_end "end", Title's pair times match its segments, Old Take is in hidden_layers and Icon is in precomp_layers.

The opening gives the count, the proposal and the leave-outs, then ends on one question about the layer; the 'show me' turn gives one idea sentence, the demo with Edit > Undo, one 'look at' sentence, and hands back the three remaining pairs with 'Say done'.
